results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Optional (if run identifier or repository context is unknown)] [Prerequisite]: Locate a relevant run using GITHUB_LIST_WORKFLOW_RUNS_FOR_A_REPOSITORY (paginate/filter; capture workflow_runs[].id).
[Optional (if run listing is empty but you still need CI signal for a ref)] [Prerequisite]: Query check results using GITHUB_LIST_CHECK_RUNS_FOR_A_REF (identify candidate failures to target).
[Required] [Step]: Fetch and verify run metadata using GITHUB_GET_A_WORKFLOW_RUN (confirm status/conclusion, ref/commit, run_attempt).
[Optional (if a specific retry attempt must be debugged)] [Next Step]: Fetch attempt-scoped metadata using GITHUB_GET_A_WORKFLOW_RUN_ATTEMPT (confirm the attempt context).
[Required] [Step]: Enumerate jobs using GITHUB_LIST_JOBS_FOR_A_WORKFLOW_RUN (paginate; use jobs[].conclusion/name and step summaries when present; capture jobs[].id).
[Required] [Step]: Download selected job logs using GITHUB_DOWNLOAD_JOB_LOGS_FOR_A_WORKFLOW_RUN (scan for the first actionable failure marker and nearby context).
[Optional (if logs are huge/noisy or client truncates)] [Step]: Extract a small failure window using COMPOSIO_REMOTE_WORKBENCH (return only the most relevant error region).
[Optional (if diagnostics are emitted as artifacts)] [Next Step]: List run artifacts using GITHUB_LIST_WORKFLOW_RUN_ARTIFACTS (find reports/outputs not visible in console logs).
[Fallback (if per-job logs are missing/empty/404 or not actionable)] [Fallback]: Download whole-run logs using GITHUB_DOWNLOAD_WORKFLOW_RUN_LOGS (offline inspection).
known_pitfalls: [GITHUB_GET_A_WORKFLOW_RUN] 404 Not Found can occur when a valid run identifier is queried against the wrong repository context; confirm by listing runs first.
[GITHUB_GET_A_WORKFLOW_RUN] conclusion may be null while status indicates the run is still in progress; avoid treating results as final until completed.
[GITHUB_LIST_JOBS_FOR_A_WORKFLOW_RUN] Some completed jobs can return an empty steps array; rely on job conclusion plus GITHUB_DOWNLOAD_JOB_LOGS_FOR_A_WORKFLOW_RUN for step-level details.
[GITHUB_DOWNLOAD_JOB_LOGS_FOR_A_WORKFLOW_RUN] details text may include a UTF-8 BOM and ANSI escape codes; normalize before searching for error markers.
[GITHUB_DOWNLOAD_WORKFLOW_RUN_LOGS] downloads are often short-lived and may intermittently 404/410; the archive can also be large and inconvenient to handle inline.

reference_workbench_snippets.description: Normalize BOM/ANSI and extract small windows around likely failure markers from GITHUB_DOWNLOAD_JOB_LOGS_FOR_A_WORKFLOW_RUN details text

GITHUB_GET_A_WORKFLOW_RUN.description: Gets a specific workflow run by its ID from a GitHub repository.

repo.description: Name of the repository (case-insensitive, without .git extension).

owner.description: The username or organization name that owns the repository (not case-sensitive).

run_id.description: Unique ID of the workflow run.

exclude_pull_requests.description: If true, excludes pull request data; the `pull_requests` array in the response will be empty.

GITHUB_LIST_JOBS_FOR_A_WORKFLOW_RUN.description: Lists jobs for a specific workflow run in a GitHub repository.

page.description: The page number of the results to fetch. For more details, see "[Using pagination in the REST API](https://docs.github.com/rest/using-the-rest-api/using-pagination-in-the-rest-api)."

filter.description: Filters jobs by their `completed_at` timestamp. `latest` returns jobs from the most recent execution attempt of the workflow run. `all` returns all jobs for a workflow run, including from previous execution attempts.

run_id.description: The unique identifier of the workflow run for which jobs are to be listed.

per_page.description: The number of results to return per page, with a maximum of 100. For more details, see "[Using pagination in the REST API](https://docs.github.com/rest/using-the-rest-api/using-pagination-in-the-rest-api)."

GITHUB_DOWNLOAD_JOB_LOGS_FOR_A_WORKFLOW_.description: Downloads logs for a specific job in a GitHub Actions workflow run, contingent on the repository's existence and the job ID being valid and having produced logs.

repo.description: The name of the repository, without the `.git` extension. This name is not case-sensitive.

owner.description: The account owner of the repository (e.g., user or organization). This name is not case-sensitive.

job_id.description: The unique identifier of the job for which to download logs. You can obtain this from the 'List jobs for a workflow run' endpoint.

GITHUB_DOWNLOAD_WORKFLOW_RUN_LOGS.description: Downloads logs for a specific GitHub Actions workflow run as a ZIP archive containing log files for each job in the workflow.

repo.description: The name of the repository (e.g., 'Spoon-Knife') without the `.git` extension. This name is not case-sensitive.

owner.description: The account owner of the repository (e.g., 'octocat'). This name is not case-sensitive.

run_id.description: The unique identifier of the workflow run (e.g., 12345).
